title: Reza Khan seizes Tehran in a coup
summary: Cossack Brigade officer Reza Khan and journalist Zia'eddin Tabatabaee marched into Tehran with troops and took control of the government.
reason: Persia was weak, divided and under foreign influence, and reformers and British officials wanted a stronger central government.
significance: It brought Reza Khan to power; he became Reza Shah and founded the Pahlavi dynasty.
